title: PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI
summary: One attachment of a spatial tendon on an articulation link, applied as PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI:<name>. The parser reads the local attachment point (scaled by the link's world scale), the parent link and the parent attachment's instance name for every attachment, root and leaf included.
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied instance is published at its resolved value; parentLink when authored.

columns.name: physxTendon:<inst>:gearing
columns.absent: 1.0. Not read for a root attachment, whose gearing is always 1.

columns.name: physxTendon:<inst>:parentAttachment
columns.absent: No parent attachment instance; with parentLink this attachment has no parent.

columns.name: physxTendon:<inst>:parentLink
columns.absent: No parent: valid only for the root. The first of several targets is used, with a warning.

interactions.rule: Auto-applies this API with the same name; the parser classifies the instance as the root.
Auto-applies this API with the same name; the parser classifies the instance as a leaf.
Attachments are read only on emitted bodies (articulation links).

notes: Instance names are arbitrary (one per tendon), so the compiled cache declares every physxTendon:* column.
